tools.name: rossum_get_current_user
tools.description: The Rossum user this connection signs in as, with its organization and roles. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/auth/user.

tools.name: rossum_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the user can see (usually one). Rossum API: GET /api/v1/organizations.

tools.name: rossum_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces: the groups that hold queues. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/workspaces.

tools.name: rossum_list_queues
tools.description: List queues, where documents wait for extraction and review. Each queue names its workspace, schema and inbox. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/queues.

tools.name: rossum_get_queue
tools.description: Get one queue by id, with its schema, inbox, workspace and automation level. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/queues/{id}.

tools.name: rossum_list_schemas
tools.description: List extraction schemas (the fields Rossum captures). Rossum API: GET /api/v1/schemas.

tools.name: rossum_get_schema
tools.description: Get one extraction schema by id, with its fields and datapoint definitions. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/schemas/{id}.

tools.name: rossum_list_inboxes
tools.description: List inboxes: the e-mail addresses that send documents into queues. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/inboxes.

tools.name: rossum_list_users
tools.description: List users in the organization, with active state and last login. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: rossum_list_annotations
tools.description: List annotations (one processed document in a queue) with status, queue and modification times. Filter by queue and status, e.g. status to_review. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/annotations.

tools.name: rossum_get_annotation
tools.description: Get one annotation by id: status, queue, document, assignee and timestamps. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/annotations/{id}.

tools.name: rossum_get_annotation_content
tools.description: Get the extracted data of one annotation: each field with its value, confidence and position. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/annotations/{id}/content.

tools.name: rossum_search_annotations
tools.description: Search annotations with a MongoDB-style query object (for example {"status": "to_review"}) or a query_string. Search results can lag a few seconds behind changes. Rossum API: POST /api/v1/annotations/search (read only).

tools.name: rossum_list_documents
tools.description: List uploaded documents with creation time, original file name and attachment status. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/documents.

tools.name: rossum_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by id: file name, page count, creation time and attachment status. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/documents/{id}.

tools.name: rossum_list_automation_blockers
tools.description: List the reasons documents were not processed automatically (for example a missing field or a validation rule). Filter by annotation id. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/automation_blockers.

tools.name: rossum_start_annotation
tools.description: Start validating an annotation: it is assigned to this user and opens for review. Changes the annotation status to reviewing. Rossum API: POST /api/v1/annotations/{id}/start.

tools.name: rossum_confirm_annotation
tools.description: Confirm the validated data of an annotation. Confirmed annotations can be exported and trigger the queue's hooks and workflows. Rossum API: POST /api/v1/annotations/{id}/confirm.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rossum_list_queues, rossum_get_queue, rossum_search_annotations · Private data: rossum_list_queues, rossum_list_inboxes, rossum_list_annotations, rossum_get_annotation, rossum_list_documents, rossum_get_document, rossum_list_automation_blockers · Public sink: rossum_list_inboxes, rossum_search_annotations, rossum_start_annotation, rossum_confirm_annotation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rossum_list_queues, rossum_get_queue, rossum_search_annotations · Private data: rossum_list_queues, rossum_list_inboxes, rossum_list_annotations, rossum_get_annotation, rossum_list_documents, rossum_get_document, rossum_list_automation_blockers · Public sink: rossum_list_inboxes, rossum_search_annotations, rossum_start_annotation, rossum_confirm_annotation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
